name: JTEKT Corporation
summary: JTEKT Corporation manufactures and sells steering systems, driveline components, bearings, machine tools, electronic control devices, and home accessory equipment in Japan, the United States, the rest of North America, Europe, the rest of Asia, Oceania, China, and internationally. It operates through Automotive, Industrial and Bearings, and Machine Tools segments. The company offers steering systems and drivelines for the automotive industry; bearings for industrial machinery; and control machines and industrial heat furnaces.
